content: नाशः [नश्-भावे घञ्] .²1 Disappearance; गता नाशं तारा उपकृतमसाधाविव जने <ls>Mk. 5. 25</ls>. .²2 Frustration, destruction, ruin, loss; नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति <ls>Bg. 2. 40</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 88</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 67</ls>; so वित्त˚, बुद्धि˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Death. .²4 Misfortune, calamity. .²5 Abandonment, desertion. .²6 Flight, retreat. .²7 (In <ab>arith.</ab>) Elimination. .²8 Want of apprehension, non-perception (अनुपलम्भ).
